title: The Small Test Before the Big Bet
short_teaser: A pilot, prototype, sample, or limited launch can reveal demand and problems before a large investment is made.
story: A pilot, prototype, sample, or limited launch can reveal demand and problems before a large investment is made. The goal is not to prove the idea is perfect, but to learn what is true. A small experiment can replace expensive certainty with useful evidence. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A small experiment can replace expensive certainty with useful evidence. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
